The *Dassanattika* ("Triad on Vision") is a canonical Abhidhamma text cataloged as Patthana 7.8 within the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Classified as a leaf section in the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text forms part of the systematic conditional analysis of dhammas structured around the triad of states abandoned by insight or vision.

 Computational analysis via DharmaNexus reveals extensive structural and textual reuse within the Pali *Paṭṭhāna* literature, identifying 55 matching passages distributed across 15 canonical texts [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial reuse occurs with other conditional matrices, most prominently *Vipākattikādi, Hetuduka* (Patthana 10.11; 10 matches, longest segment §0.1–2.1 ↔ §0.1–2.1), *Vitakkattikādi, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.15; 7 matches), and *Sanidassanattika, Cūḷantaraduka* (Patthana 10.13; 4 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Close formulaic overlaps also connect it to neighboring triads such as *Ācayagāmittika* (Patthana 7.10) and *Dassanahetuttika* (Patthana 7.9), as well as homonymous treatments in later sections such as Patthana 13.8 and Patthana 19.8 [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan meet the alignment threshold [DharmaNexus].
